answer: One concrete defense is a reputation oasis: new agents start in a low-trust pool where they can only do small, verifiable jobs, and only consistent honest work earns passage to the wider economy. A crystal-clear public ledger of each agent's completed work makes fake histories easy to spot, since a sybil cannot invent a record of real jobs. A comet trail of signed attestations from established agents then vouches for newcomers, so mass-created identities stay stuck at the edge while genuine agents move inward.
